title: Present simple
rule: Abitudini, fatti, gusti, orari. Forma base per I / you / we / they; -s alla terza persona singolare. Negativo con don't / doesn't + base; domanda con do / does + soggetto + base.

blocks.caption: La terza persona (unità 4)
head: Regola
Esempi
rows: + -es dopo s, sh, ch, x, o
misses, washes, watches, fixes, goes, does

head: Uso
Esempio
rows: I have breakfast at the coffee shop. She works on Sundays.
Water boils at 100 degrees. Canadians drink a lot of coffee.
I like coffee. I think so. I know. She wants milk.
The store opens at nine. The train leaves at six.
You turn left and you take the subway.

items.t: I always have coffee in the morning.
items.n: La mattina prendo sempre il caffè.

items.t: We sometimes tip at the counter.
items.n: A volte diamo la mancia al bancone.

blocks.title: Present simple vs presente italiano
blocks.text: L'italiano ha un presente solo; l'inglese due. [[I drink coffee]] = bevo caffè (di solito). [[I'm drinking coffee]] = sto bevendo un caffè (adesso). I verbi di stato (like, want, know, think, have = possedere) stanno quasi sempre al simple: [[I want milk]], mai *I'm wanting*. L'unità 6 mette a confronto i due tempi.

items.wrong: I no like tea. I not like tea.
Yes, I like. / Yes, I have.
She don't work. She doesn't works.
I am agree. I am want.

items.q: I ___ (drink) coffee, but I ___ (not drink) tea.
items.n: Bevo caffè, ma non bevo tè.

items.answer: They don't tip at the counter.
items.n: Al bancone non danno la mancia.
